sourceFile: 21. TIU C11-20  Report Test change film D25-10-25 2026.1.29. - RAW soundcheck_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has valid row references but misgroups the primary change and includes noisy measurement outcomes.
issues: Primary changed factor is film stack change, not Normal vs Day shift/model.
Baseline/test conditions are mislabeled; side, date, shift, and model should be subgroup context.
Review title is taken from a graph header instead of the report title.
Several measurement outcomes are header/mask/frequency parses, not clear comparison results.
Critical changed-factor evidence should include the content row stating the film change.
correctionPlan: Set changedFactor to Normal D25+5+D25 vs changed Film D25+10+D25.
Move TIU C11-20L/R, dates, and shift into subgroup keys only.
Use the Test sheet report title and purpose/content rows for review metadata.
Keep function NG-rate rows and valid SPL/THD comparisons; remove header/mask-only stats.
Add Test!8 and relevant result rows as changed-factor evidence.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist, but citations are insufficient until grouping and noisy outcomes are corrected.
